ranking.name: Gator 1 Party Fire Engine/Mr Bucks Bus

text.text_excerpt: Three cheers for Gator 1! We got to ride this around town for the Brews Cruise and our lovely CM Morgan gave us special permission to review this one of a kind party transport system. As others have described, the Gator 1 is a party bus that has been magically transformed from a fire truck. If that's not cool enough, you are in a covered but open vehicle where you are standing (and holding onto the safety bar) as you are driven from spot to spot (complete with sirens and honking). Don (the captain of Gator 1) was awesome and kept the tunes pumping and he helped us maneuver getting in and out of the truck safely. This is probably the most fun party bus type thing that I have ever been on. ...

What's loud, red and fun allover??? Gator 1, that's what!!! Had an absolute blast riding around the retrofitted fire engine as it took my group and me to three breweries around the city. Captain Don is the nicest guy and very attentive. The fire engine is equipped with a sound system you can plug your smartphone into and plenty of room for you to bring a cooler with your adult beverages. It is standing room only and open so you can interact with the folks on the street just like the parade floats. While Don is a super careful driver and great at maneuvering the fire truck I recommend pacing yourself with those drinks ;-) :-) Gator 1 is great for a fun carefree day/night out on the town an...

Gator 1 is amazing! We had such a great time. It's New Orleans. We're not tourist so we don't want a regular ole party bus! Us locals want something unique and fun! That's exactly what Gator 1 is. The driver was so awesome. He was on point with the sirens and horn. Between the music, sirens, and horn we never stopped dancing and partying! Can't wait to ride Gator 1 again!!
